text:
noah-ops: Heads-up: APAC GPU pool failing to provision after the natgw egress hardening rolled at 01:00. Nodes stuck at 'auth + fetch' and can't reach KMS proxy. Current healthy pool 5/12.

lina-sre: Can you paste the node bootstrap log? is it a TCP RST or 403 from proxy?

noah-ops: log snippet: `2026-04-14T01:12:34Z ERROR bootstrap: auth fetch failed: dial tcp x.x.x.x:443: connect: connection refused; kms-proxy: 502 bad gateway`

maria-sec: We tightened the NAT gateway egress policy to only allow approved service CIDRs to external proxies. The KMS proxy cluster moved AZs during deploy; its node IPs fell outside the new allowlist.

deploy-bot: Deploy apac-egress-harden v2 -> completed. Canary noticed 2/3 proxy AZs changed IPs.

cost-bot: Alert: apac-gpu-pool down 58% (expected 12 -> 5). Fallback capacity allocated in us-west, estimated extra cost +$4.6k/day.

sam-ml: Impact: several training jobs will miss deadlines. We need a quick fix that isn't full rollback.

lina-sre: Quick mitigations: 1) add current kms-proxy AZ CIDR to egress allowlist 2) add a temporary natgw exception for proxy IPs 3) revert hardening. Least blast is 1. Who can patch?

maria-sec: I can patch the egress policy, but I want to avoid a huge CIDR sweep. Do we have the proxy service tag/role we can allow instead?

noah-ops: Proxy runs in our account but uses ephemeral ENIs. Best short term is to allow the service tag `svc-kms-proxy-apac` which maps to the current ENI set. If not available, add the AZ CIDR `10.120.4.0/22` temporarily.

maria-sec: Applying service-tag allowlist now. Internal command: `infractl egress allow --service-tag svc-kms-proxy-apac --duration 60m`

maria-sec: Patch applied. Rolling monitor.

deploy-bot: Health check: kms-proxy endpoints reachable from apac-natgw.

noah-ops: Requeued canary joins: 7/7 success within 45s. Nodes are joining normally.

cost-bot: Pool restored. Cost projection adjusted back. :white_check_mark:

lina-sre: Follow-ups: - add proxy service-tag validation to egress hardening playbook - add a pre-flight to ensure service-tag-to-eni mapping exists before policy flip - include a post-deploy smoke from node subnets to KMS proxy and audit-shipper.

maria-sec: Also: add a CI job that rotates one proxy AZ and verifies natgw allowlist behavior. We should avoid relying on brittle IP lists for ephemeral services.

sam-ml: I'll stagger job restarts to avoid thundering herd when nodes come back online. Thanks.

noah-ops: Opening follow-up ticket: infra/EGRESS-2467 (add proxy-tag-check + canary). Runbook snippet added: `If NATGW egress hardening causes nodejoin failures: allow service-tag or AZ CIDR for KMS/audit proxies, run canary joins, then schedule narrow grant review during maintenance window.`

lina-sre: We'll also add an alert: "node join auth failures after egress changes" that triggers paging to infra + sec for < 15m sustained.

noah-ops: Closing thread for now. Ping if any regression.
